build._doc: Fossify Phone. gradle task + keystore signing. apk_glob finds the assembleRelease output under the typical Fossify build path.

gh_release._doc: Rolling GH release 'latest' (shared across the ea_cloud-* apps; each contributes a distinctly-named APK asset), overwritten every main push so https://github.com/diegonmarcos/cloud-unix/releases/latest/download/cloud-comms-dialer.apk stays stable. Published by `build.sh gh-release-fork dialer` (ship-cloud-dialer.yml), which uploads dist/cloud-comms-dialer.apk with --clobber. Consumed by ea_cloud-superapp ui.external_apps[cloud-dialer].install_apk_url. The immutable timestamped per-build release (RSS notification) is separate and stays --latest=false.
